title: Key Account Management
overview: Key Account Management equips sales and customer-facing professionals to develop profitable, long-term relationships with strategically important customers. The program moves beyond transactional selling to structured account selection, stakeholder understanding, value creation, collaborative planning, and disciplined execution. Participants learn to assess account potential, navigate complex buying groups, protect retention, identify growth opportunities, and monitor account health using practical tools and measurable objectives.
audience: Key account managers, account executives, and strategic sales representatives.
Sales managers, business development managers, and commercial team leaders.
Customer success, client relationship, and corporate account managers.
Professionals responsible for retaining, growing, or coordinating major customer accounts.
methodology: Facilitated discussions, account portfolio analysis, stakeholder-mapping workshops, customer scenario studies, role-play negotiations and review meetings, value proposition exercises, account plan development, peer feedback, and a final account strategy simulation.
competencies: Key account identification, prioritization, and portfolio management.
Account intelligence, stakeholder mapping, and relationship development.
Customer needs discovery, consultative selling, and value-based communication.
Account planning, opportunity development, and cross-functional coordination.
Commercial negotiation, customer retention, risk management, and performance review.
objectives: Distinguish key account management from general sales and transactional account servicing.
Select and segment key accounts using strategic fit, value, potential, and risk.
Map decision makers, influencers, users, and relationship coverage within an account.
Diagnose customer objectives, challenges, buying processes, and growth opportunities.
Build differentiated value propositions and joint account development plans.
Conduct effective executive reviews and coordinate internal account teams.
Manage renewals, commercial discussions, escalations, and competitive threats.
Track account performance and prepare a practical 90-day improvement plan.
